changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: An installation is on a user or an organization account, and an instance admin's decision is one of three.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE github_installation_request ADD CONSTRAINT ck_github_installation_request_account_kind CHECK (account_kind IN ('USER', 'ORGANIZATION'))
ALTER TABLE github_installation_request ADD CONSTRAINT ck_github_installation_request_status CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'DECLINED', 'ADOPTED'))

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE github_installation_request DROP CONSTRAINT ck_github_installation_request_status

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The deciding admin and the adopted workspace are plain ids. Deleting either keeps the decision and clears only the reference.

changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='public.auth_event'::regclass AND conname='ck_auth_event_event_type' AND contype='c'

changeSet.comment: Preserve every existing audit event type and admit an instance admin's decision on a GitHub App installation.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE auth_event DROP CONSTRAINT ck_auth_event_event_type; ALTER TABLE auth_event ADD CONSTRAINT ck_auth_event_event_type CHECK (event_type IN ('USER_VIEW', 'LOGIN', 'PASSKEY_CHANGED', 'PASSKEY_VERIFIED', 'LOGIN_FAILED', 'LOGOUT', 'TOKEN_REFRESH', 'JWT_REVOKED', 'IDENTITY_LINKED', 'IDENTITY_UNLINKED', 'IMPERSONATION_BEGIN', 'IMPERSONATION_END', 'ACCOUNT_DELETED', 'EXPORT_REQUESTED', 'PERSON_DATA_PREVIEWED', 'PERSON_DATA_EXPORTED', 'PERSON_DATA_ERASURE_REQUESTED', 'APP_ROLE_CHANGED', 'RESEARCH_CONSENT_REVOKED', 'WORKSPACE_ELEVATION', 'INSTALLATION_EVENT_REPLAYED', 'GITHUB_INSTALLATION_ADOPTED', 'GITHUB_INSTALLATION_DECLINED', 'LLM_CONNECTION_CREATED', 'LLM_CONNECTION_UPDATED', 'LLM_CONNECTION_DELETED', 'LLM_MODEL_CREATED', 'LLM_MODEL_UPDATED', 'LLM_MODEL_DELETED', 'LLM_MODEL_PRICE_CHANGED', 'LLM_MODEL_SHARING_CHANGED', 'LLM_SETTINGS_CHANGED', 'LOGIN_PROVIDER_CREATED', 'LOGIN_PROVIDER_UPDATED', 'LOGIN_PROVIDER_DELETED', 'SILENT_MODE_CHANGED', 'PUBLIC_ACTIVITY_CHANGED', 'RESEARCH_DATASET_RELEASED', 'RESEARCH_REMOVAL_RECORDED', 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_DESTINATIONS_CHANGED', 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_CLEANUP_CONFIRMED', 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_FILED_BY_ADMIN')) NOT VALID;

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Check the existing audit rows in a later transaction, so the scan does not block audit writes.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE auth_event VALIDATE CONSTRAINT ck_auth_event_event_type
